rv.q: As a certain police officer once said, The Guy Who Didn’t Like Musicals is “f**kin’ transcendent!” – and utterly unmissable.
We all enjoy a grassroots musical theatre success story, so it feels like an uncomfortable truth to acknowledge that the show itself simply isn’t very good.

cn.t: Critics are divided on Starkid's cult musical: one hails its phenomenal physicality and gripping horror as a West End triumph, while another finds it doesn't transcend its devoted fanbase despite clear audience enthusiasm.
